nodes.question: How do frontline actors aim to combat climate shocks according to the insights provided in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Frontline actors prepare for climate shocks with the aim of maintaining food production, which indirectly supports food security.
nodes.paragraph: In some instances, data-based solutions to climate risks and shocks present even greater risks to producer agency than climate risks and shocks themselves. Richards et al.attention on the nexus of climate shocks and the security of food production in Minority World contexts, such as Aus - tralia, the site of this study. Based on data collected through face-to-face interviews with pastoral beef producers in Cen - tral Queensland, this paper provides insights into the ways in which frontline actors prepare for climate shocks and aim to maintain the production of food, indirectly contributing to food security. Extensive cattle grazing properties are increasingly becoming the focus of exogeneous climate mitigation and adaption strategies or solutions to climate change. nodes.question: What is the focus of the Climate Smart Agriculture Alliance (CSAA) in Zambia?
nodes.answer: The CSAA focuses on planting indigenous crop species within water catchment zones to protect water resources for future use.
